source_datasets.name: 2020 National Population and Housing Census, Basic Tables Volume 1, Table 3.5: population in private households by religion and region
source_datasets.provider: Vanuatu Bureau of Statistics (VBoS) / Pacific Community (SPC)

licence.name: no explicit licence; SPC/VBoS research-use acknowledgement
licence.attribution: Vanuatu Bureau of Statistics and the Pacific Community (SPC)

source_datasets.citation: Vanuatu Bureau of Statistics (2022). 2020 National Population and Housing Census, Basic Tables Volume 1.
source_datasets.notes: Extracted with scripts/extract_vu_census_religion.py; the published table is internally inconsistent by plus or minus 1-2 across rows (pattern consistent with cell perturbation), verified against the PDF text layer and identical in the VBoS Version 2 file. Counts reproduced for research with acknowledgement; formal redistribution terms unconfirmed.

indicators.label: Religion-response denominator
indicators.description: People in private households with a stated religious-affiliation response in the area and census year (census total minus refusals and not-stated).
indicators.method: Total from Basic Tables Volume 1 Table 3.5 minus refuse-to-answer and not-stated.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Vanuatu area councils and urban municipalities, geoBoundaries ADM2
indicators.quality_notes: The published 2020 table is internally inconsistent by plus or minus 1-2 (consistent with cell perturbation); treat small differences as noise.

indicators.label: Religious affiliation %
indicators.description: Share of the stated-response denominator affiliated with any religion, including customary beliefs.
indicators.method: Stated denominator minus no-religion, over stated denominator.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Vanuatu area councils and urban municipalities
indicators.quality_notes: Customary beliefs count as religious affiliation. Category boundaries changed between 2009 and 2020 (Latter Day Saints separated from Other; Not Stated added).

indicators.label: No religion %
indicators.description: Share of the stated-response denominator reporting no religion or faith.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Vanuatu area councils and urban municipalities
indicators.quality_notes: 2020 label is No Religion/Faith; 2009 label is No religion.

indicators.label: Places of worship
indicators.description: OpenStreetMap amenity=place_of_worship points assigned to the area.
indicators.method: Point-in-polygon assignment of the current OSM snapshot.
indicators.temporal_coverage: current snapshot, repeated across census years
indicators.quality_notes: Includes some nakamals as tagged in OSM; not a census-year measure.

indicators.label: Places per 10,000 residents
indicators.description: Current place count per 10,000 stated-response residents in the census year.
indicators.method: Place count over stated denominator, times 10,000.
indicators.quality_notes: Numerator is the current OSM snapshot, not a census-year place count.

indicators.label: Places per km²
indicators.description: Current place count per square kilometre of geodesic land area.
indicators.method: Place count over geodesic land area from the boundary geometry.

indicators.label: Customary beliefs %
indicators.description: Share of the stated-response denominator reporting customary (kastom) beliefs.
indicators.method: Denomination count over the stated-response denominator.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Vanuatu area councils and urban municipalities
indicators.quality_notes: The headline diversification signal: nationally 14.6% of adults in 1967, concentrated in Tafea (Tanna), falling across later censuses. Customary beliefs count as religious affiliation.

indicators.label: Presbyterian %
indicators.description: Share of the stated-response denominator affiliated with the Presbyterian Church.
indicators.method: Denomination count over the stated-response denominator.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Vanuatu area councils and urban municipalities
indicators.quality_notes: The largest denomination nationally; strongest in the central islands (Shefa, Malampa).

indicators.label: Anglican %
indicators.description: Share of the stated-response denominator affiliated with the Anglican Church (historically the Melanesian Mission).
indicators.method: Denomination count over the stated-response denominator.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Vanuatu area councils and urban municipalities
indicators.quality_notes: Concentrated in the north (Torba/Banks and Penama).

indicators.label: Catholic %
indicators.description: Share of the stated-response denominator affiliated with the Roman Catholic Church.
indicators.method: Denomination count over the stated-response denominator.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Vanuatu area councils and urban municipalities
indicators.quality_notes: Scattered across the archipelago; the 1967 label is Roman Catholic.

indicators.label: Seventh-day Adventist %
indicators.description: Share of the stated-response denominator affiliated with the Seventh-day Adventist Church.
indicators.method: Denomination count over the stated-response denominator.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Vanuatu area councils and urban municipalities
indicators.quality_notes: A minority denomination present in every census wave.

data_status_note: Census religious affiliation and denomination shares are live for area councils and urban municipalities in 2020. 2009 sub-provincial religion was published by island, not area council, so 2009 stays pending at this level. The Torres area council is absent from the geoBoundaries ADM2 layer, so its 2020 counts are not mapped at this level.
